ترا (form I)
# تَرَّا (tarrā) /tar.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of تَرَّ (tarra)
# تُرَّا (turrā) /tur.raː/: second-person dual imperative of تَرَّ (tarra)
# تِرَّا (tirrā) /tir.raː/: second-person dual imperative of تَرَّ (tarra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
